metadata.description: AgentX for Cursor — production tracing for your own agent, and evaluation triage against a self-hosted AgentX engine

plugins.name: agentx
plugins.description: Get your agent's real runs into AgentX, then score them, then turn what they measure into a code fix. /instrument sets up a Python agent and proves it with traces it reads back; /run-eval evaluates it against a dataset it can also create - templates, files, or cases curated from live traces; /eval-fix triages the evaluation against the source and re-runs it on the same dataset.
